description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeMigrationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query instance ID.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts stop-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsb2c11sxpi3j0000 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
